name: CreateBoltCoor_4Bolts
formula: =LAMBDA(spacingX,spacingY,[CenterX],[CenterY],LET(Cx, IF(ISOMITTED(CenterX), 0, CenterX), Cy, IF(ISOMITTED(CenterY), 0, CenterY), bolt_1, HSTACK(-spacingX / 2, spacingY / 2), bolt_2, HSTACK(spacingX / 2, spacingY / 2), bolt_3, HSTACK(-spacingX / 2, -spacingY / 2), bolt_4, HSTACK(spacingX / 2, -spacingY / 2), {ref}TranslateCoor(VSTACK(bolt_1, bolt_2, bolt_3, bolt_4), Cx, Cy)))
